scope.entrypoint: An explicitly enabled user chat only.
scope.ordinary_search: M4 deterministic documentation search is not called, changed, ranked against, or made dependent on chat RAG.
scope.retrieval_mode: Retrieve only published local evidence from the active chat locale; cross-locale prose retrieval and fallback are forbidden.
scope.not_a_quality_substitute: Chat retrieval need not be more relevant than ordinary search. A lower-coverage result is useful only as an explicit no-evidence abstention, never as an unsupported factual answer.

local_evidence.allowed: Only current published, reviewed chunks with the exact active locale and a resolvable local topic/anchor URL.
local_evidence.citation: Each retained evidence item carries its published local URL and stable topic/anchor identity. Chunks, scores, and model output are never citations.

candidate_artifact.resource_measurement: BPM093-M2-02 clean-host CPU-only protocol; a changed swap counter invalidates selection.
candidate_artifact.selection_order: Among candidates that pass every hard boundary, rank by same-locale evidence coverage and citation readiness; tie is no selection. This is not a comparison to ordinary-search relevance.

optional_external_evidence.activation: Later M7/M8 work requires explicit user opt-in, a reviewed provider/scope policy, and visible external-source state.
optional_external_evidence.ordering: Retrieve and label local BPM evidence independently before any permitted external request; do not silently merge conflicts.
optional_external_evidence.persistence: External content never enters local chunks, embeddings, indexes, model training, or persistent chat knowledge.
optional_external_evidence.citation: External claims require their own labelled external citation.

verification.next: BPM093-M5-03C produces ignored candidate reports; BPM093-M7 proves generated-answer grounding and abstention.
